method: Recompute local selector semantics, global extension equivalence, reconstruction, and P7 preservation from C0+C2 only.

local_selector: Selector h_{C,M} has list M and neighborhood D_C.
Given outside coloring c, proper selector color exists iff some alpha in M is absent from colors(D_C)=F_C(c).
Therefore h_{C,M} is colorable iff M is not a subset of F_C(c).
min_bad_logic: C0 good masks form a down-set and bad masks an upset.
Every bad mask contains an inclusion-minimal bad mask.
Thus mu_C(F)=1 iff no M in MIN_BAD(C) is contained in F.
Hence all selectors of C are simultaneously colorable iff mu_C(F_C)=1.
global_forward: Restrict an original extension to U.
For every selector choose alpha in M\F_C; such alpha exists because the original extension makes F_C good.
Selector independence makes these choices mutually compatible.
global_reverse: Restrict any H* list-coloring to U.
For each C, selector properness implies F_C is good.
All residual components are coupled by C2, so actual F_C is nonempty and has a stored C0 witness.
Insert that witness; X0 compatibility is already encoded in B_C, seed is anticomplete, dynamic complete-neighbor colors are excluded by F_C, and different Y0 components are anticomplete.
replay.exact_outside_lists: A(u)=[4]\f(N(u)∩(S∪X0)) is required for semantic equivalence; replacing it by source L_P(u) would violate the B1B0 firewall.
p7: H* is obtained from an induced subgraph of Q_ALL by independent false-twin blowups of component nodes.
An induced path on at least four vertices contains at most one vertex of an independent false-twin class.
Collapse each selector used by a hypothetical P7 to its Q_ALL component node; all path adjacencies/nonadjacencies are preserved.
This would produce an induced P7 in Q_ALL, contradiction.
replay.size: At most six selectors per residual component, hence O(n) selector vertices.
replay.four_list: [4] can coexist with no other MIN_BAD mask for the same component because MIN_BAD is an antichain.

limitations: No solver for the resulting P7-free mixed-list graph is proved.
No transfer from ordinary P7-free List-3 to mixed 3-subsets of [4].
